intro: Dev-call intelligence - the running capture of what our daily calls cover (in-product, carriers/vendors, data & servicing), the goals we're driving, the blockers in the way, and items that still need a task. Auto-summarized from the Gemini call recap.
note: Populated by CIH from the Gemini dev-call recap email after each call. (The site is static - the on-page button loads the last CIH-published notes; CIH regenerates this from the newest Gemini email.)
goals: Lock the ILIA status model - split statuses into account, enrollment, and policy groups, map carrier-provided statuses (Allianz 14, National Life 8) one-to-one into those buckets, and keep underwriting/requirements under enrollment.
Finish the master-settlor data load - pull missing settlor emails where the settlor is not the insured, and overwrite trust names/EINs with verified Provident data so DBR can reprocess.
Close the illustrated-surrender-value gaps - run Tranche 67+ now and clean up the nine Tranche-66 policies still missing data.
Ship the Payments Center incrementally - land the new payment UI (annual baselines, audit history, rejection workflow) and sync its fields into Tranche Management and ePay for reporting.

Fix tranche mechanics - loosen ePay tranche-number locking so not-yet-in-force policies stay editable, restrict bulk moves to a single owner, and add a system Close-Tranche function that auto-advances prospects.

latest_call.title: Daily Sync / Dev Office Hours
latest_call.lede: Daily sync + dev office hours. Three decisions landed: Confluence is the single centralized hub for infrastructure and project tracking, a Jira task is now required for all DocuSign work, and a new case-details checkbox will flag clients on systematic/monthly crediting (~155 affected; Shounak drafting specs, Mohit to run a targeted scraper). Jamin is finalizing the ILIA standard model - carrier-specific vs. a single unified standard - and launched the centralized ILIA Hub on Atlassian (pulls from Jira). The main open thread is carrier document delivery: required proposal, certificate of trust, and life-application supplement aren't reaching the carrier via ILIA and are handled by manual email today; Mohit is investigating folding them into the DocuSign envelope while the team confirms exact needs. Document-display bugs (NIWD-2128/2129/2130) and the historical-document import (NIWD-1626) are in progress; Domo annual reports and DocuSign data-label population were resolved.

items.text: Systematic / monthly-crediting checkbox - add a case-details checkbox so admins can flag clients on systematic or monthly crediting; the toggle drives confirmation-statement processing (~155 users affected; targeted scraper requested).
ILIA standard model - Jamin finalizing; decision pending on carrier-specific standardizations vs. a single unified ILIA standard. Options doc to review with Judy + Shounak.

Centralized ILIA Hub launched on Atlassian - pulls from Jira; houses infrastructure docs, feature sets, daily standups, backlog prioritization and bug triage. Still need to pull individual participant pages into the infrastructure section.

Carrier document-delivery gap - required proposal (client-initialed), certificate of trust, and life-application supplement are not reaching the carrier via ILIA; handled by manual email today. Investigating whether to fold them into the DocuSign envelope templates.

Carrier requirement confirmation - confirm the carrier's exact document needs and whether email transmission is acceptable; the group to compile the required-document list. An upcoming e-signature implementation may resolve the process gap.

Historical document import - Google script in progress to organize legacy client documents into folders for upload into ILIA under the correct policy numbers; cleaning up missing illustrated values in parallel.

Servicing/enrollment + document-display bugs - rejected servicing action items appearing on the enrollment list (urgent hot fix); an old ID document showing instead of the approved one; document 'date modified' showing today's date. Front/back sync explains some date discrepancies; investigating why older documents persist.
Resolved this call - Domo annual reports and DocuSign data-label population fixed; Chris to file Jira tickets for the DocuSign fixes so they track in Confluence.
Confluence is the centralized hub for all team infrastructure, feature documentation, and project-management tracking.
Jira task creation is required for all DocuSign work, to keep a record tracked in Confluence.
Case-details systematic/monthly-crediting checkbox approved for build.

themes.name: Centralized ILIA Hub (Confluence / Atlassian)
themes.latest: Confluence/Atlassian designated as the single centralized hub for infrastructure docs, feature sets, and project tracking; pulls directly from Jira and hosts daily standups, backlog prioritization and bug triage. Remaining: pull individual participant pages into the infrastructure section.

themes.name: Systematic / Monthly-Crediting Checkbox
themes.latest: Approved: a case-details checkbox lets admins flag clients on systematic or monthly crediting; the toggle informs confirmation-statement processing (~155 users affected). Shounak drafting specs; Mohit to run a targeted scraper.

themes.name: Carrier Document Delivery via DocuSign
themes.latest: Required proposal (client-initialed), certificate of trust, and life-application supplement are not reaching the carrier via ILIA (manual email workaround). Investigating whether to fold them into the DocuSign envelope; confirming exact carrier needs and whether email is acceptable.

themes.name: ILIA Standard Model (Carrier-Specific vs Unified)
themes.latest: Jamin is finalizing the ILIA standard model; open decision on whether to keep carrier-specific standardizations or consolidate into a single unified ILIA standard. Options/decisions doc to be reviewed with Judy and Shounak.

themes.name: Agent Client List — Per-Policy View
themes.latest: Agent/admin client list shows only one policy for clients holding several. Fix: give every policy its own entry and add a dedicated policy-number column, rather than grouping them under one client header.

themes.name: Bank Loan Interest-Rate Reconciliation
themes.latest: Historical bank-loan (WinTrust) data shows per-account discrepancies (~$30k on some) traced to incorrect/blended interest rates (e.g. a missing 7.5% rate). Plan: audit source loan documents year-by-year, determine correct rates, and build a formula to reconcile bank data against system records — theoretical until proofed.

themes.name: Workload Delegation & Operations Handoff
themes.latest: Servicing, inbox, and non-urgent sales feedback move from the tech team to the operations/UFC team to cut task volume. Non-technical support routes to Operations/Todd; sales feature-requests go to Judy. Shounak to help train the UFC team.

themes.name: AI Integrations for Servicing Automation
themes.latest: To reduce manual servicing load, compile the list of required system connections/integrations for the AI build-out to automate data extraction.

themes.name: Simsaw Vendor Capacity
themes.latest: Dev vendor Simsaw flagged as a bottleneck — one contact handles all communication plus significant ad-hoc work. Weighing a second point of contact or restructured comms; leadership to raise added resources with the vendor, though budget for new hires is uncertain.

themes.name: Illustrated Values Data (Domo)
themes.latest: Reported data problems with illustrated values surfacing in Domo to be investigated.

themes.name: Trust Naming — Numbering Fix
themes.latest: Automated logic wrongly appended a number to single-policy trust names. Fix: skip numbering on the first trust, number only from the second policy onward — applied as a logic change on the trust-naming task.

themes.name: Document Folder Workflow & Auto-Generation
themes.latest: Set a protocol keeping formal/historical documents separate from automated ILIA uploads, and pushed to auto-generate per-tranche document folders instead of creating them manually. Tranche folders to be audited for missing amendments/delivery receipts.

themes.name: National Life Allocation Form & Import Updates
themes.latest: New National Life allocation form under review; system-import requirements to be updated for the new form and index selections. Kyle confirming requirements for the product updates.

themes.name: Status Standardization (Account / Enrollment / Policy)
themes.latest: Aligned on splitting ILIA statuses into account, enrollment, and policy groups and mapping carrier-provided statuses one-to-one (Allianz 14, National Life 8) rather than a custom internal bucket. Underwriting/requirements sit under enrollment; policy status stays high-level (issued/surrendered/inactive). Jamin to add a visual breakdown of all status types to the planning doc.

themes.name: Agent Offboarding & Access Review
themes.latest: A departing agent (now with a competitor) is having ILIA account access disabled while their clients keep servicing access; the agent is directed to contact servicing for information. Downloaded-document activity was tracked via FullStory (screenshots can't be confirmed) and compiled for legal to weigh non-compete enforcement. Broader offboarding protocol still to be formalized with management.

themes.name: National Life DocuSign Certificates
themes.latest: Completion certificates aren't captured/named for National Life the way they are for Allianz (they save to the storage bucket but stay unnamed). Future National Life applications will mirror the Allianz auto-save process; no retroactive backfill needed.

themes.name: Irrevocable Trust 'Tranche B' Handling
themes.latest: Revocable-to-irrevocable trust conversions will be identified with a status/flag and a 'Tranche B' filter that keeps clients in their original tranche (funding dates and payment timelines stay synced), plus a Domo report formula to segregate them for the bank - avoiding a new tranche or DB rebuild. Requirements and DocuSign needs to be confirmed before configuration.

themes.name: ePay Tranche Lock / Not-In-Force Editing
themes.latest: Policies get locked when moved to the next tranche as an ePay payment posts near the deadline, blocking edits. The lock triggers when payment is marked received (intended behavior), but it will be loosened so policies that aren't yet in force stay editable.

themes.name: Automated Tranche Closing
themes.latest: Build a system Close-Tranche function that auto-advances remaining prospects to the next tranche, replacing manual bulk transfers and reducing errors. Bulk moves to be restricted to one designated owner; historical tranches to be closed once all in-force policies are verified.

themes.name: Great Wealth Transfer Review
themes.latest: GWT review continuing. New this call: add a lookup so a client inviting a family member who already holds a policy doesn't trigger duplicate invite emails or data cleanup — folded into the active GWT update work.

themes.name: Systematic Allocation Change Form (Sept 26)
themes.latest: New carrier allocation-change form due Sept 26. Two options being weighed (stop new + terminate existing on next monthly transfer vs. stop new + run existing to depletion). Client/agent outreach planned to move off monthly crediting. No update this call.

themes.latest: Uploading trunch + client files to the bank Dropbox/Egnyte; document locations still being defined. Final docs go to the carrier when sent per client; trunch-specific docs pull at the trunch-master stage. No update this call.

themes.latest: Annual-review data task under review. Before re-enabling annual reviews, confirming with the vendor that reactivation won't trigger automated client notices. SARS (suspicious-activity reports) re-enabled and considered fixed.

themes.latest: Master-settlor emails to be pulled where the settlor is not the insured, and trust names/EINs overwritten from the verified Provident list; DBR task updated to require emails so it can reprocess. No update this call.

themes.latest: New payment UI - annual baselines, expectation statuses, rejection workflow with supporting-doc requests, and full audit history - to be mapped into Tranche Management and released in stages. No update this call.

themes.latest: Tranche 66 pulled with 9 of 94 missing data; approved to run Tranche 67+ while the Tranche-66 gaps are cleaned up. No update this call.
